title: Roasted Vegetable Dal Casserole
description: A hearty, comforting casserole made with roasted vegetables and a rich, flavorful dal sauce. Perfect for a cozy Italian-inspired dinner.
instructions: In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat. Add the onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic, carrot, zucchini, and eggplant to the skillet. Cook for an additional 5 minutes.
In a separate saucepan, combine the dal, tomato, salt, and black pepper. Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat and simmer for 20-25 minutes, or until the dal is tender.
In a 9x13 inch baking dish, arrange a layer of the roasted vegetables. Spoon half of the dal sauce over the vegetables, followed by half of the remaining vegetables.
Repeat the layers, ending with a layer of dal sauce on top.
Cover the dish with aluminum foil and bake for 25-30 minutes.
Remove the foil and continue baking for an additional 10-15 minutes, or until the top is lightly browned.
Remove from the oven and let cool for a few minutes before serving.
